description: This file defines the MediaFilterController class in Drupal, responsible for rendering media preview responses, handling CSRF checks, and checking if media embed filters are used in text formats.

classes.name: MediaFilterController
classes.description: Controller class for rendering media preview, managing CSRF validation, and checking media embed filter usage within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting renderer, media storage, and entity repository services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the controller with services from the container.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Generates a filtered HTML preview of media content, handling CSRF validation and media entity loading.

methods.name: formatUsesMediaEmbedFilter
methods.description: Checks if the media embed filter is enabled for a given text format.

methods.name: checkCsrf
methods.description: Validates CSRF token in the request headers, allowing anonymous access if the token is present.
